description: A Java class that handles animated zoom gestures, providing zoom control with smooth interpolation, start, abort, and force finish functionalities.

classes.name: Zoomer
classes.description: A class that animates double-touch zoom gestures with smooth interpolation and control methods.

methods.name: forceFinished
methods.description: Sets the zoom finished state without changing the current zoom value.

methods.name: abortAnimation
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing zoom animation and sets current zoom to the end zoom.

methods.name: startZoom
methods.description: Starts a zoom animation from 1.0 to (1.0 + endZoom).

methods.name: computeZoom
methods.description: Calculates the current zoom level; returns true if zoom is ongoing, false if finished.
